estimand: Retrospective event-time pooled BTC option aggressor amount versus next completed BTC-PERPETUAL 30-minute traded bar-close log return; not receipt-time or midpoint.
phase: Independent calendar-period validation of a September-selected no-flow model; retrospective availability assumptions
print_policy: All returned BTC option prints included; raw combo/block metadata retained without inferred causal interpretation

chronological_split.training: 256 prior half-hour origins, mature labels only, crossing September/October boundary
chronological_split.evaluation: 32 fixed origins Oct1 00:00 through Oct4 21:00UTC; labels at origin+30min
chronological_split.selection: Model selected on September; no October tuning

bar_publication_assumption: Zero publication lag after bar end is assumed for retrospective replay, not empirically guaranteed.
